story.title: Dainik Bhaskar and Indian Publishers File CCI Complaint Against Google Over AI Search Revenue Sharing
story.summary: Dainik Bhaskar, one of India's largest Hindi-language media groups, has joined other publishers in filing a complaint with the Competition Commission of India against Google, citing concerns over unfair revenue sharing as AI-driven search reduces traffic to news websites. The publishers allege that Google's AI-powered search summaries are displaying their content without adequate compensation. This filing marks a significant escalation in the global publisher-versus-platform dispute, now formally entering India's competition regulatory arena.
